prepared.content: MioPages is moving to one managed Web Presence service. Local service businesses and trades are included alongside professional and technical firms. The existing customer sign-in is separate from acquisition. Do not offer retired legacy services.

The managed offer helps customers make their business clearer online and give interested visitors a next step. Launch organizes business knowledge, offerings, pages, navigation and a supported contact route. Ongoing keeps the site current and uses observations to recommend useful changes, subject to review. An operator can provide supported work. Offer the Free Web Presence Review as a useful diagnostic, including when MioPages is not a fit, and present Direct Start as a distinct option. Do not promise a price, turnaround, outcomes, migration or integration beyond confirmed scope.

evidence.brandBrief: Use the approved MioPages wordmark, warm neutrals and purple, restrained contrast, readable Sans at 18 px, and service-led v3 with motion off. Lead with what a buyer can gain, use direct mobile actions, and design diagrams or examples around a specific decision.

briefs.label: Business knowledge through ongoing improvement
briefs.prompt: A clean wide editorial vector-like diagram with three visually distinct connected stages: organizing the knowledge of a service business, publishing a clear page with a visible visitor choice, and making a small improvement based on an observation. Deep purple, cream and restrained sand. Clear at mobile size. No text, logos, customer photos, analytics values or represented outcomes.

briefs.label: What a Free Review gives a buyer
briefs.prompt: A clearly fictional visual artifact showing a short website-review report with three prioritized findings and a next-step panel. Use symbolic shapes instead of text or numerical values. Editorial composition using warm neutrals, deep purple and sand accents. Do not show any real business, case study, logo or screenshot.

briefs.label: Keep or change an existing site
briefs.prompt: A small editorial comparison diagram illustrating an existing service-business page splitting into two distinct decisions: preserve useful information and improve an unclear visitor route. Purple on warm cream, simple shapes, no words, live customer screens, logos or promised outcomes.

briefs.label: Mobile-first revision of the service illustration
briefs.prompt: A mobile-readable variant of a three-phase managed website service diagram: business knowledge, a page with a visitor action, and one reviewed improvement. Large distinct shapes, one clear reading direction, deep purple and warm neutral ground with a sand accent. No text, logo, real metrics or customers.

independentAcceptance.required: Research-backed choice of primary audience, comparison with DIY and agency routes, concrete buyer outcome from Launch through Ongoing, grounded in the staffed offer within the Home opening.
Distinct Free Review and Direct Start in the Home Hero. Independent reviewer must see both on a representative mobile viewport and complete both private journeys through safe preview targets.

Replan page membership where required, give every retained page a buyer job and link it into the rendered navigation or contextual journey. Inventory and test every reachable route without capping pages.

Use only verified experience and permissions. Withhold customer results, experimental status, diagnostic language, internal constraints, pricing and unverified claims. Refuse material leakage and anchor proof to its customer-facing purpose.

Require a useful and recognizable C0 service explanation or illustrative Review artifact, exact canonical wordmark, and editorially verified desktop and mobile placements. Reject generic filler, misleading proof and weak crops before spending on a revision or accepting.

cycle.review: Independent reviewer exercises the two journeys, validates sources and contrast, reads the whole rendered site across desktop and mobile and either refuses it or signs the exact candidate and media. Replan direction and IA or fully rewrite affected pages in scope. Revise and rerender before founder review. Stop if any item persists or budget or authorization fails.
